title: Keep a voice-only master and stems
statement: Keep a clean voice-only master and separate music stems, so that a later edit to the picture or the score never forces regenerating approved speech.
detail: The handover's export rules for a narrated film ask for a clean voice-only version and separate music stems, so that later edits do not require regenerating speech. They also ask for an uncompressed or provider-original master where feasible, beside browser-compatible delivery files. The rule covers edits to the picture or the score; a change to the speech itself still needs a new take.
against: A change of pace still forced new speech: "2:54 at 158 words a minute: a new brisk take, no words cut, no time-stretch" (g9/film/v07/README.md, line 10). Stems cannot absorb a change to the speech itself.

evidence.quote: Retain a clean voice-only version and separate music stems so later edits do not require regenerating speech.
Preserve an uncompressed or provider-original master where feasible and create browser-compatible delivery files.
